sinopsis.es: Ahmedabad, en el estado de Gujarat, bastión político de los nacionalistas hindúes. Las hermanas Pathan, supervivientes de los pogromos antimusulmanes de 2002, viven bajo la protección de su padre y su abuela en un barrio periférico de la ciudad. A medida que crecen, el pasado las alcanza.
sinopsis.en: Gujarat, West of India. Sofia and Suzain are two teenage sisters brought up in a humble household, taken care of by their father since their mother left. They were too young to remember, but 20 years ago, their family barely escaped the deadly 2002 Gujarat anti-Muslim riots. Refusing the grim day-to-day routine and the shadow of the past, Sofia and Suzain want to embrace life to the fullest. While they grow up, reality comes knocking.
